date_text: Thu, Aug 20th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Aug 23rd • 10:00 PM AEST
description: This Thursday, we’re handing over the taps to La Sirène Brewing for a great showcase of farmhouse ales, sours, fruit-driven beers and a couple of cracking classics. Known for brewing with a distinctly European influence and an Australian sense of adventure, La Sirène make beers packed with character — think fresh raspberries, whole Seville oranges, local honey, tart citrus, chocolate and hazelnut, alongside beautifully made saisons, pale ales and pilsner. On Tap: • Praline — 5.8%, Rich chocolate and hazelnut stout. • Raspberry Praline — 5.8%, Praline loaded with fresh whole Yarra Valley raspberries. • Seville — 4.5%, Hoppy pale ale brewed with fresh whole Seville oranges. A proper citrus bomb. • Citray Sour — 4.5%, La Sirène’s famed sour ale with fresh citrus flesh, juice and zest. • Villages — 4.5%, Bright, refreshing hoppy farmhouse ale. • Queen Bee — 6.5%, Their classic saison brewed with fresh local honey. • Raspberry Orange Table Beer — 3.4% A complex, easy-drinking table beer with fresh orange and whole raspberries. • DDH Pale — 4.8%, Fresh, aromatic and generously double dry-hopped. • Pilsner — 4.9%, Crisp, refreshing and built for another one. All tapped from Thursday and pouring until the kegs run dry. No set finish date. No guarantees they’ll last the weekend.
